summary: V36 bug-fix verification. Backend regression suite (6/6 PASS) proves the /api/contacts sort was changed to created_at DESC and that q/area/group_id filters and multi-tenant isolation still work. Backend fix confirmed working. Frontend E2E was blocked in this Playwright session: repeated logins from the web preview did not persist an auth token to localStorage (SecureStore on web) — after clicking [data-testid="login-submit"] the URL stays on /login and subsequent /api/* calls return 401 across contact/new, /contatti, /calendario and /master. I could not verify the two frontend fixes end-to-end. Code review of the two frontend changes shows both fixes are correctly implemented (StatMetrics.tsx:106-112 navigates first then closes modal via setTimeout(0); server.py:1216 sort is `('created_at', -1)`). Note: iteration 35 successfully logged in with the same credentials/testIDs, so this may be a transient environment issue rather than a real regression, but a next run should verify.

integration_issues.issue: In this Playwright session, login POST appears to not persist the JWT (localStorage contains only 'app_bg_at_v1', no token key). Any full page reload / page.goto after login redirects back to /login and all API calls return 401. Not reproduced via curl (backend /api/auth/login returns 200 with token). Likely transient — iteration 35 saw the same UI login work — but flagging for main-agent verification.

action_items: Main agent should manually verify the two frontend fixes in a live browser (not Playwright) since backend is proven correct and code review of StatMetrics.tsx + created_at DESC sort both look right.

Investigate why the web login flow did not persist a token in a fresh Playwright browser context — check whether expo-secure-store on web correctly writes to localStorage during automated runs (may relate to CORS, cookie policy, or async race between setToken() and page.goto).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1216 — sort correctly changed to `.sort([('created_at', -1)])`. Verified by pytest that a newer contact appears at index 0 while an older one appears below. ✓

StatMetrics.tsx:106-112 — onPress now correctly does router.push FIRST, then setTimeout(() => onClose(), 0). This matches the fix description and is the recommended pattern for iOS/Android Modal + router race. ✓

contact/new.tsx:1190-1201 — post-create-skip-btn navigates via router.replace('/contact/{id}') as expected; user then relies on useFocusEffect in /contatti to refetch. Since backend now returns newest-first, the newly created contact WILL appear at index 0 once /contatti is re-rendered. Logically correct.

success_rate.frontend: N/A — login blocked in Playwright session (see integration_issues)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fix is fully verified — do not re-run backend unless code changes. For frontend: the seeded appointment `a_36d21b162f6f` (TEST_APPT_CLICK_v36 at today 15:00, area=energy, owner test@) is confirmed to exist via curl. The two flows to re-verify are: (1) login → /contact/new → fill NEWCT_<ts>+Zulu → save → click post-create-skip-btn → click Contatti tab → assert data-testid^='contact-' first card contains NEWCT_<ts>. If Playwright login still can't persist token, try: (a) use in-app navigation only after login (no page.goto), or (b) inject the token directly via `page.evaluate` into localStorage under the expo-secure-store keyspace before navigating.
rca_of_issue: Bug 1 RCA (already fixed by main agent): backend GET /api/contacts sorted by last_name asc caused newly created contacts (esp. with last_name 'Zulu') to appear far down the scroll. Verified pytest confirms new fix `sort([('created_at', -1)])` returns newest first. Bug 2 RCA (already fixed): drill onPress closed modal before router.push, and on some platforms the Modal's unmount cancelled the pending navigation. Fixed by pushing first, then setTimeout(0) close. Code inspection confirms fix in StatMetrics.tsx:106-112.
